notes.title: Minor Update - Extra Settings.
notes.content:
A minor update that has been requested by some players was for the option to turn off the Film Grain effect. We have now added a Toggle button to the Settings menu inside Options.

Settings you have chosen are now saved for your next playthrough.
Other minor graphical bug fixes.

We have some extra story we have worked on that will expand to more paths in the game, so keep an eye out for that update coming very soon.

Thanks for playing and for the feedback and apologies for not updating sooner.

If you are enjoying the game please consider leaving us a review.

Thanks from us at Paranormal Games.
